blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Write-time re-review on 2026-07-31 of the sole tracked Base deployment 0xc0d3700000987c99b3c9009069e4f8413fd22330. Sourcify's exact-match ABI exposes ERC-20 transfer/transferFrom, facilitator mint/burn, owner/guardian administration, and pauseBridge/unpauseBridge/lzPause, but no isBlacklisted, blacklist, freeze, seize, pause(), or paused() surface. At Base block 49332025 (timestamp 2026-07-30T23:16:33Z), live eth_call returned owner=0xc0D3700924301AC384E5Eae3272E08220752DE3D, guardian=0x0D1d0f89cb988678B37FD5b5c6C1A5bBdc55f8ba, lzPause=false, and totalSupply=6,150,000e18; paused() reverted. The deployed ABI/bytecode exposes pauseBridge (0x7dd0480f) and lzPause (0x3771e259) while the blacklist/freeze selectors isBlacklisted (0xfe575a87), blacklist (0xf9f92be4), pause (0x8456cb59), and paused (0x5c975abb) are absent. branchApplicability.rationale: Ruled on an exhaustive on-chain enumeration, not on absent branch documentation. cdxUSD is a GHO-style token whose complete minting surface is its own facilitator registry, so the number of price-sensitive paths is directly readable. At Base block 50735165 (base-rpc.publicnode.com) and block 50735166 (mainnet.base.org) on 2026-09-01, getFacilitatorsList() returned exactly one entry, 0xfEfcb2fb19b9A70B30646Fdc1A0860Eb12F7ff8b, on both endpoints; at block 50735520 getFacilitator on that address returned label "Multisig" with bucket capacity 100,000,000 cdxUSD and level 6,150,000 cdxUSD, equal to totalSupply, unchanged from the block-50539797 read of 2026-08-28. The facilitator is a Safe (VERSION 1.4.1) with threshold 3 over 9 owners at the same block; token owner() is 0xc0D3700924301AC384E5Eae3272E08220752DE3D and the token exposes no price-oracle accessor. The whitepaper's Cod3x Lend borrower-liquidation facilitator and its liquidity and arbitrage AMOs are therefore not deployed as facilitators on the live token: there is no second minting authority that could carry a per-market collateral or liquidation branch, and the registry read is complete rather than sampled. Exactly one price-sensitive path stands, the Safe facilitator's discretionary mint against strategy collateral it values under rules the protocol does not publish; the top-level record fully describes this exposure, where tier opaque-or-unknown already carries that exposure. This is an enumerated absence of branches, not an unavailability of branch detail; if a Cod3x Lend facilitator is later added to the registry the disposition must return to branches-required.

routes.reviewNote: At Base block 50064182, the sole authored deployment is the native CdxUSD token with a Facilitator mint/burn path and totalSupply of 6,150,000 cdxUSD. Its inherited OFT extension has no configured peers for the common LayerZero EIDs checked, and an exhaustive PeerSet query from the deployment block through block 50064182 returned zero events; no remote representation is active. routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Base block 50064182, all queried common LayerZero EIDs returned zero peers and an exhaustive PeerSet query from the deployment block through block 50064182 returned zero events; no destination representation is active.
routeChecks.rateLimits: hourlyLimit() and slidingHourlyLimitUtilization() both returned 0 at Base block 50064182; with the deployed check, positive outbound transfers fail the current hourly-limit test. The Timelock can set per-EID balance limits and hourly limits through its delayed path.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Timelock owner can set peers, per-EID limits, guardian, message inspector, pre-crime address, delegate, and bridge pause state after the 24-hour delay. These are bridge controls and do not expand native Facilitator issuance.
